verdict.rationale: Superhuman's own docs reference read statuses: Team Read Statuses (docs-49, docs-71) and MCP workflows that 'check which emails have been read' (docs-25, docs-31). Community threads independently confirm that its tracking tells senders how many times and from where a recipient opened an email (comm-1, comm-3). The community criticism is about privacy ethics, not about whether the feature works. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party documentation of the individual read-status UI, and explicit evidence that open timestamps ('when') are shown to the sender.
